title: Tab (aka \t, ^I) breaks the parsing of .gdextension from godot.
body:
### Tested versions

godot: 3911e0963d39b79a85cb329340c6918397d2d05e
godot-cpp: 1c8db40a64da65587ccfa6087232c8f8bc24a1ee

### System information

6.19.10-arch1-1 | 16UD70R-GX5EK (0.1) | AMD Ryzen 5 7530U (12) @ 4.55 GHz | AMD Barcelo [Integrated]

### Issue description

When gdextension contains as tab '\t', '^I' parser does not think it as a whitespace character, resulting godot faulty behaviour, and this feature seems not to be documented.

If okay, I would like to fix this behaviour.

Following is the log of the result.
```
ERROR: Error loading GDExtension configuration file: 'res://libdanye.gdextension'.
   at: parse_gdextension_file (core/extension/gdextension_library_loader.cpp:279)
ERROR: GDExtension dynamic library not found: 'res://libdanye.gdextension'.
   at: open_library (core/extension/gdextension.cpp:740)
ERROR: Error loading extension: 'res://libdanye.gdextension'.
   at: load_extensions (core/extension/gdextension_manager.cpp:333)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Write any simple gdextension with tab in it.

This is an example for x86_64-linux like.
change `^I` to actual tab character.
```example.gdextension
[configuration]
entry_symbol = "libmain"^I# comment thing
compatibility_minimum = "4.2"
reloadable = true

[libraries]
linux.debug.x86_64 = "./libexample.so"
linux.release.x86_64 = "./libexample.so"
linux.x86_64 = "./libexample.so"
```

Place any valid godot extension shared object `libexample.so`.
Try loading on your godot engine project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

res://project.godot
res://example.gdextension        # see `steps to reproduce`
res://libexample.so                    # any valid gdextenson compiled.
